intelligence.enrichment: Secondary sexual characteristics are natural signs that the body is preparing for adulthood and they mark the onset of puberty. Puberty includes external and internal changes during adolescence. puberty begins -> secondary sexual characteristics appear -> body shows preparation for adulthood The learner classifies features such as voice change, facial hair, chest hair, and breast development as secondary sexual characteristics that mark puberty and preparation for adulthood. Puberty is just any visible body change that makes someone look older.
